release_notes: V14.44 build 249 adds dynamic vertical scaling to the 1-hour mini trend, selectable 1-to-12-hour glucose trend and insulin-activity screen. Each graph scales from the values visible in its selected time window, includes the configured glucose limits, adds proportional headroom and prevents readings above 15 mmol/L from being clipped. The mini trend now includes gap-aware connecting lines and colored points. The insulin screen dynamically scales both its glucose overlay and IOB axis. Existing Nightscout recovery, shared 12-hour RAM buffer, mini-trend backfill, WebUI buzzer control, physical buzzer controls, dual-button forced backfill, ketone history, WhatsApp alerts, factory reset and OTA protections remain active.
